title: DOUBLY-ROBUST LLM-AS-A-JUDGE: EXTERNALLY VALID ESTIMATION WITH IMPERFECT PERSONAS

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating covariate shifts by altering the mixture of rater demographic groups (e.g., gender, race, age, education) and content characteristics between source and target populations to measure discrepancies in Generative AI system quality estimates.

Modeling rater attrition and non-response by varying the probability that items are rated (e.g., simulating dropouts due to failed attention checks or task abandonment) to evaluate the impact of missing human ratings on evaluation estimates.
